content.value_statement: Teams often repeat workflows but lack a shared format for AI assistant skills. This skill gives clear structure, naming rules, and validation steps for reusable skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains when a repeated workflow should become a reusable skill.
Defines the expected skill directory layout and SKILL.md placement.
Provides a SKILL.md template with required frontmatter and sections.
Lists naming, description, and file size rules for skill authors.
Shows BPSAI validation commands for checking skill formatting.
Summarizes common validation errors and direct fixes.
limitations: Uses BPSAI CLI examples that may not apply to every repository.
Focuses on Claude-style skill documents, not every agent plugin format.
Does not verify security or runtime behavior of newly created skills.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn repeated team procedures into consistent AI skill documents with shared naming and formatting rules.

use_cases.title: Draft a New Skill
use_cases.description: Use the template and checklist to outline a new skill before adding detailed workflow steps.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Formatting
use_cases.description: Check a skill draft against frontmatter, naming, length, and validation expectations before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Identify a Skill Candidate
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repeated workflow and decide whether it should become a skill. Explain the trigger conditions, expected users, and why documentation helps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Skill Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill outline for this workflow using the recommended sections. Include a clear name, short description, steps, examples, and validation checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Naming and Frontmatter
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill draft for naming, frontmatter, description length, and directory alignment. Return specific fixes for each issue found.

prompt_templates.title: Refine for Marketplace Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this skill for focus, repeatability, clear triggers, useful commands, and avoidable generic content. Recommend changes before publication.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for recurring release note reviews.
output: Purpose: standardize release note checks before publication.
Core sections: trigger conditions, review steps, examples, and validation checklist.

output_examples.input: Check whether my skill name is valid: code_review.
output_examples.output: The name should use lowercase words separated by hyphens. A better name is reviewing-code because it follows the gerund convention.

output_examples.input: Prepare a final validation checklist for my skill draft.
output: Confirm only name and description appear in frontmatter.
Confirm the description is short and third-person.
Confirm the document stays focused and includes actionable steps.

best_practices: Create skills only for workflows that repeat across sessions or teams.
Use lowercase hyphenated gerund names that match the skill directory.
Keep SKILL.md focused, actionable, and short enough for easy review.
anti_patterns: Documenting broad knowledge that an AI assistant already handles well.
Adding unsupported metadata fields to the skill frontmatter.
Creating a skill without clear triggers or repeatable steps.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create reusable AI skill documents for repeated workflows, team procedures, and standardized processes.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides structure, examples, and validation guidance for authors who create the files.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What frontmatter fields are expected?
faq.answer: The skill expects only name and description fields in SKILL.md frontmatter.

faq.question: Can it help review an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes checks for naming, description style, file length, and validation issues.

faq.question: Is it specific to one repository?
faq.answer: Some CLI examples use BPSAI tooling, but the authoring guidance is useful for similar skill repositories.
